summary: Tom Cline voted no on a Gaza ceasefire resolution at a February 2024 Gilroy council meeting and seconded a motion to reject 'any and all' ceasefire resolutions, as reported by the Mercury News. Rather than merely declining to support a ceasefire, he actively backed a motion that would foreclose any future ceasefire resolutions by the council. In his capacity as District 5 city councilmember, this is affirmative opposition to ending the military campaign in Gaza.
